{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "esol_length_ring_prior_transfer",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "short_chain_prior_positive",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_short"},
          "weight": 0.45,
          "rationale": "Source ESOL evidence gave smiles_short a positive effect (+6.89, n=261); small solutes favored solvation."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "mid_length_prior_negative",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": -0.3,
          "rationale": "Source prior for smiles_mid was negative (-6.61, n=226); transferred with reduced magnitude given low confidence."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "long_chain_prior_negative",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_long"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Strongest source value prior (-11.46, confidence 0.47): large lipophilic solutes lose solvation favorability."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_role_from_hbond_donor",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Source hbond_donor_bin maps to target hetero_atom_bin (transfer weight 0.51); donors drove favorable source effects."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.3,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.15,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.01,
      "confidence": 0.4,
      "hypothesis": "Transfers ESOL solubility structure (length priors plus donor-to-heteroatom role) to hydration ranking. May fail because FreeSolv hydration magnitude grows with polar surface, so size penalties could invert for polar mid-length solutes."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "polar_surface_hydration_mechanism",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_strong_hydration",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.75,
          "rationale": "Dense O/N centers form multiple water hydrogen bonds, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "apolar_saturated_hydrocarbon_penalty",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none", "aromatic_bin": "aromatic_none"},
          "weight": -0.7,
          "rationale": "Pure saturated hydrocarbons offer no hydrogen-bond sites; cavity formation dominates, giving weakest hydration."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "heavy_halogenation_hydrophobic",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Polyhalogenated solutes are weakly polar and bulky, historically poor hydration despite high polarizability."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "counter_mid_length_penalty_reversal",
          "conditions": {"smiles_length_bin": "smiles_mid"},
          "weight": 0.2,
          "rationale": "Counter-hypothesis: reverses the low-confidence source smiles_mid penalty, since larger polar solutes accumulate hydration sites."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.5,
      "prior_scale": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.2,
      "ucb_weight": 0.45,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.5,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.2,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.6,
      "hypothesis": "Hydration affinity tracks polar hydrogen-bonding surface rather than chain length, so heteroatom content leads and the uncertain length prior is reversed. Fails if the score rewards hydrophobic bulk or halogen polarizability."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polar_surface_hydration_mechanism",
  "lesson": "Source ESOL roles had low confidence (0.16-0.41) and the length prior is the weakest link; mechanistic polarity terms are safer carriers for a hydration objective.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept a literal source-prior transfer skill with damped length weights, and added a counter-hypothesis skill that leads with heteroatom polarity, penalizes apolar saturated and polyhalogenated solutes, and reverses the uncertain smiles_mid penalty. Selected the mechanistic polarity skill for frozen deployment."
}
